Description: Fetch role-access records matching HTTP method+path. Cache-first (Redis) then DB fallback. Called by every service's AccessGuard on every authenticated request.
Criticality Reason: Hot path — every authenticated request across platform hits this. Failure = complete platform outage.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics for cache hit/miss ratio or latency histogram.
Notes: Highest priority endpoint. Should add cache hit/miss metrics.

Description: Paginated list of all role-access records with filtering.
Bulk-grant role access to multiple routes. Checks duplicates. Invalidates Redis cache per route.
Criticality Reason: Grants access permissions in bulk. Incorrect grants create unauthorized access.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger injected. domainEvent(ROLE_ASSIGNED/ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_FAILED) per route. Auto instrumentation.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics for bulk grant count.
Notes: Domain events fire per-route in bulk operation.

Description: Toggle isAccessRemoved (grant/revoke). Finds by PK. Invalidates Redis cache.
Criticality Reason: Controls role access to API routes. Security-critical toggle.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger injected. domainEvent(ROLE_REVOKED or ROLE_ASSIGNED based on toggle). Auto instrumentation.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics for permission changes.
Notes: Good — distinguishes grant vs revoke in domain events.

Description: Reads routes from body (non-standard GET), diffs against existing, bulk-creates new ones.
Criticality Reason: Registers new API routes. Failure means new endpoints can't be permission-controlled.
Observability Gap: Winston not SDK. No domain events. GET-with-write-body is REST anti-pattern.
Notes: REST anti-pattern: GET method that writes. Should be POST.

Description: Paginated list of all registered routes.
Existing Observability: SDK auto spans. Logging commented out.
ObservabilityLogger: logger.info('log app controller'). SDK auto HTTP span.

Prometheus metrics scrape endpoint provided by SDK.
